subject: [PATCH 51/60] mm: restrict explicit migration to N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts explicit migration to N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY nodes, allowing memory policy operations on these nodes while keeping private node memory isolated. It introduces a new function `folio_allows_mempolicy()` and updates various functions in the mm module to use this new function.
